verdict.rationale: DeepInfra's own docs say the same inference cloud serves vision/OCR multimodal models, Whisper speech recognition, text-to-speech, and FLUX/Stable Diffusion image generation and text-to-video alongside LLMs. That covers every modality the story names. The evidence is catalog-level first-party description, not detailed per-modality API reference. Missing for 10: endpoint-level docs showing how to call image/audio/vision models (request formats, parameters), independent or hands-on corroboration of these modalities working.

support.subject: As a developer, I can call vision, audio, or image-generation models beyond text chat on the same platform

citations.quote: DeepInfra is an AI inference cloud that makes it simple to run the latest machine learning models at scale — LLMs, vision, embeddings, image generation, video generation, speech, and more.
FLUX, Stable Diffusion, text-to-video, and more.
Multimodal models for visual understanding and document text extraction.
